title: cypripedium macranthos var. ventricosum
intro: Cypripedium macranthos var. ventricosum, commonly known as the ventricose lady's slipper, is a species of orchid native to East Asia, characterized by its unique, slipper-shaped flowers. The health benefits of Cypripedium macranthos var. ventricosum include its potential to aid in the treatment of fever, rheumatism, and inflammation, as well as its ability to boost the immune system. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its anti-inflammatory, antipyretic, and immunomodulatory properties, which contribute to its traditional use in Eastern medicine. The bioactive constituents of Cypripedium macranthos var. ventricosum include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
